% Pattern: head/case. "Case (I)." and "Case (II)." number the cases with the
% capital Roman numerals in the parentheses. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want head-1 other/case (I)
% want head-2 other/case (II)
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Let $x$ be a point.

\paragraph{Case (I). } Suppose that $x=0$. Then the claim is clear.

\paragraph{Case (II). } Suppose that $x\neq 0$. Then the claim is clear too.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
